_about: Mission board fragment (List 17 #164) — template shape only; ZERO missions instanced. Missions are repeatable tasks; #138 side stories are authored, unique flag chains — the classes are fenced apart in both directions (a mission never sets story/circuit/capstone flags and never gates a #137 connection; a side story is never a template). State derives from #12-discipline facts; there is no quest-log store. The mission_board generator is PROPOSED into #90's vocabulary (its home disposes).
